chapter: Theaters, the Navy and the Singletons' partnership
title: Ethel Waters, the Lyric Theater and John Robichaux
summary: Marge says Ethel Waters claimed she brought Zutty out of New Orleans; Zutty says she taught him the Charleston at the theater. He worked the Lyric with Robichaux only after leaving the Cadillac, and after the Navy.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
